meta.title: ShortPulse — Local AI Short-Form Video Agent
meta.description: Turn a topic or script into a ready-to-post vertical video. Script, voiceover, captions, visuals and music, assembled on your own machine — no subscription.

nav.creditsRemaining: Credits remaining — click to top up

howItWorks.title: Three decisions, then it runs itself

topic.title: Give it a topic
topic.detail: One line is enough — the LLM writes the scene breakdown, the hook and the call to action. Already have a script? Paste it and the AI only splits it into scenes.

look.title: Pick how it looks
look.detail: Language, length, visual engine and caption style. The exact credit cost and an estimated render time are shown before you commit to anything.

watch.title: Watch it build, then post it
watch.detail: Progress streams live over a WebSocket, stage by stage. You get a 1080x1920 MP4 with burned-in captions and ducked music — yours to download, no watermark.

builtOn.title: Built on open source you can audit
